            'mage/validation'
        ],
        function(
            $,
            modal
        ) {
            $(function(){

                var options = {
                    type: 'popup',
                    responsive: true,
                    innerScroll: true,
                    title: '',
                    buttons: [{
                        class: '',
                            click: function () {
                            this.closeModal();
                        }
                    }]
                };
                var popup = modal(options, $("#modal-giftcard-balance-check"));
                $("#btn-giftcard-balance-check").on('click',function(e){
                    e.preventDefault();
    
                    $("#modal-giftcard-balance-check").modal("openModal");
                });
                $('#form-giftcard-balance-check').mage('validation', {});
                $('#form-giftcard-balance-check').on('submit', function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    var form = $('#form-giftcard-balance-check'),
                        method = form.attr('method'),
                        action = form.attr('action'),
                        wrapper = $('.modal-balance-content');
                        data = form.serializeArray();
                    var status = form.validation('isValid');
                    if(status){
                        wrapper.addClass('sending');
                        $('.loader').show();
                        $.ajax({
                            type: method,
                            url: action,
                            data: data,
                            dataType: 'json',
                            complete: function (response) {
                                form.find('.error-message').hide().text('')
                                wrapper.removeClass('sending');
                                console.log(123, response);
                                $('.loader').hide();
                                if(response.responseJSON && response.responseJSON.status){
                                    wrapper.html(response.responseJSON.result);
                                }else if(response.responseJSON && response.responseJSON.result){
                                    form.find('.error-message').show().text(response.responseJSON.result);
                                }else{
                                    form.find('.error-message').show().text('Something went wrong.');
                                }
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });

            });
        }
    );
